# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 25 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 35 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_025_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 25

**1** Jesus said: "Love your brother the way you love your own life. Protect him the way you protect the pupil of your eye."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "The way you love your own life" — "soul" rendered as "life" in its most basic sense
- "Protect" — more active than "guard"
- "Pupil of your eye" — "apple of the eye" rendered as the specific anatomy (the pupil)

---
